description: This file implements Windows-specific DNS configuration management for Chromium, including registry monitoring, adapter address retrieval, and DNS suffix configuration.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Windows-specific DNS configuration service handling registry monitoring, adapter address retrieval, and DNS suffix configuration.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::Watcher
classes.description: Watches registry keys and hosts file for DNS configuration changes.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration from registry and system settings asynchronously.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads and updates hosts entries, including localhost and local computer name.

methods.name: ParseDomainASCII
methods.description: Converts a wide string domain name to ASCII, handling IDN to Punycode conversion.

methods.name: ParseSearchList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of search domains from a wide string.

methods.name: ConvertSettingsToDnsConfig
methods.description: Converts Windows DNS system settings into a DnsConfig object.
